final: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS executed_count FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark GROUP BY o.ordertune), shares AS (SELECT executed_count, 1.0 * executed_count / SUM(executed_count) OVER () AS share FROM type_counts), compared AS (SELECT executed_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(executed_count) AS count_sum, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess FROM compared WHERE share > average_share
